label_format: Dispersion of {n} shots: carry {carry_mean:.1f} +/- {carry_sd:.1f} {unit}, side {side_mean:+.1f} +/- {side_sd:.1f} {unit} (+ right)

sources.views: View presets that get the sample traces: the wide down-the-line view that keeps the whole flight in the picture. Other views keep the single shot so the swing stays readable.
sources.sample_color_rgba: Colour and opacity (0..255) of every sample trace: an orange apart from the red nominal tracer, translucent so the overlapping samples read as one spread and the nominal shot stays on top.
sources.sample_width_px: Line width in pixels of each sample trace, thinner than tracer_width_px of flight_tracer_settings.json so the nominal shot is the emphasised one.
sources.label_format: HUD line of the spread: mean +/- population standard deviation of the flight model's carry and side over the available sample shots, in display units (side positive to the right). A replay-level dispersion of the varied shot setup, not a measured one.
